subject: Production update: branded kit run delay and shipping/diversion options
messages:
From: Timothy Barnes <tim@fastprintco.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production update: VIP kit embroidery delay / options

Hi Stephanie and team,

Quick heads-up from the factory: our embroidery supplier reported a thread shortage yesterday that affects the metallic-gold stitch on the premium patch for the VIP kits. At the moment we can complete approximately 300 of the 1,200 VIP kits this week (these will include the printed patch alternative we discussed). The remaining embroidered patches are on order but the lead time we’re seeing is ~12 business days.

Two pragmatic options:
1) Expedite a partial air shipment for the highest-value kits (we can ship 250–300 kits by air to arrive in time for setup on Jun 24). Estimate: additional $1,350 for freight and handling; expedited packaging fee $120.
2) Ship the full order by ground once embroidery completes — ETA Jul 6–8. No expedite fees but venue would receive later.

We can also perform a split strategy: air-ship a small VIP tranche and send the remainder by ground. I attached an updated expedite quote and a photo of the printed-patch proof (design-proof-embroidered-patch-v3.png) for your review.

Questions we need answered so we can lock manifests by EOD tomorrow:
- Do you want us to expedite a partial tranche (how many)?
- Shipping address and onsite contact for receiving?
- Any PO or billing notes for the expedite invoice?

Apologies for the disruption — we’ll prioritize your run once you confirm.

Attachments: expedite-quote-fastprint-20260617.pdf, design-proof-embroidered-patch-v3.png

Thanks,
Tim
Timothy Barnes
Account Manager, FastPrint Co.
phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Timothy Barnes <tim@fastprintco.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production update: VIP kit embroidery delay / options

Tim — thanks for the quick update and the photos. We prefer not to delay arrival for our VIP program, so we want to pursue a split: please expedite the minimum viable VIP set. Budget check below, but first can you confirm:
- Exact cost to air-ship 250 kits (not 300) to the receiving address below; include breakdown: freight / handling / customs (if any) / expedite fee.
- Will the 250 kits include the printed-patch proof in the attachment? Confirm materials for the expedited tranche.

Receiving address (Harborside Ballroom):
Harborside Events — Receiving Dock B
600 Bayfront Ave, San Francisco, CA 94105
Onsite receiving contact: Elena Ramos — elena@harborsideevents.com — +1 415-333-4408

Please send an updated expedite invoice and AWB draft so we can route payment ASAP. I’m looping in Laura and Marissa for budget/PO. We need your firm ship-by date for the 250 kits to approve.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production update: VIP kit embroidery delay / options

Stephanie / Marissa — noted. Quick notes from program budget:
- We have a discretionary events expedite bucket of $2,000 for this event. Approving up to 250 kits at the expedite cost is within that bucket if the total incremental cost is <= $1,800.
- If the freight + expedite fees exceed that, we should consider reducing the expedited tranche to 150 kits and localizing the rest to our SF merch partner (but that introduces extra handling).

Marcus — can you confirm we can route $1,800 from the events expedite line? If yes, move forward with 250 kits.

Laura

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production update: VIP kit embroidery delay / options

Laura / team — confirmed. I can approve up to $1,800 out of the events expedite budget. If Tim’s updated quote for 250 kits is <= $1,800, proceed with PO and expedite. Please include a concise billing note on the invoice: "Redwood Summit VIP expedite — PO# RS26-142" so Finance can match.

Marcus Lin
Director, Finance Operations

From: Timothy Barnes <tim@fastprintco.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Production update: VIP kit embroidery delay / options

Thanks — confirmed we can do 250 kits via air. Attached is the updated expedite invoice and the provisional AWB (awb-fastprint-250-air-20260620.pdf). Cost breakdown:
- Freight & handling (air, door-to-door): $980
- Expedited packaging + prioritized QC: $220
- Additional materials surcharge for printed patch run: $120
TOTAL incremental: $1,320 (below approved $1,800).

Ship-by: Jun 22 (pickup morning), expected on-site delivery Jun 24 by 1000h. Tracking will be provided within 24 hours of pickup. The 250 expedited kits will use the printed-patch proof attached; the remaining 950 kits will ship ground once embroidery completes (ETA Jul 7).

One logistics note: we need a named onsite receiver + mobile so the carrier can clear dock access. Please confirm Elena Ramos at Harborside Events (contact details you provided). Also confirm the billing note exactly as Marcus requested.

Attachments: awb-fastprint-250-air-20260620.pdf, expedite-quote-fastprint-20260617.pdf

—Tim

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

Tim — thanks for the speed. We approve the 250-kit expedite per the attached invoice and AWB. Billing note: "Redwood Summit VIP expedite — PO# RS26-142". Please route the invoice to finance@redwood.ai with that PO.

Elena — looping you in so Harborside has visibility on the early partial delivery on Jun 24 (about 250 boxes, palletized). Pickup will be Jun 22 AM; expected on-site Jun 24 09:00–11:00. Onsite receiving contact for Redwood: Elena Ramos — +1 415-333-4408. If there are any dock access requirements or a preferred freight door, please let us know.

Tim — please share the carrier and tracking when available. If the carrier requests proof of insurance or a delivery window, ping me immediately.

Thanks all — we’ll track the remaining 950 kits and the embroidery run separately.

—Stephanie
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
